title: If Not Now Than When
meta: Output: Diasec Print (Plexiglas + Alucobond), Fine Art Print (Hahnemühle Photo Rag / German Etching), Custom Archival on request
Framing: Diasec ready-to-hang with aluminum backing; fine art prints shipped rolled
statement:
A series of artworks centered on 'NOW'. 'IF NOT NOW THAN WHEN' really hits me when you think about life. It's a reminder that time flies and we need to make the most of the present.

Life's unpredictable and often shorter than we think, so it's important to act now instead of putting things off. Whether it's chasing a dream, fixing a relationship, or making big changes, this saying pushes us to grab opportunities and live in the moment. Waiting for the perfect time can mean missing out, so embracing the now is a great way to live a more fulfilling life.
